sources_chirho.license_chirho: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), dedicated by Global Bible Tools itself. In globalbibletools/platform@5d4041d4, src/ui/study/components/AttributionDialog.tsx gives the glosses of every language except English New Testament the use {type: "self", licenseCode: "cc0_1_0"}, which src/messages/en.json renders as "English Glosses by Global Bible Tools are available under Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal".
